import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

path = "/Users/fuzhengwei/coding/github/deepseek-harness/deepseek-harness-java/docs/architecture-vertical.drawio"
tree = ET.parse(path)  # 解析失败会抛异常
root = tree.getroot()
reserved = {"at", "as", "parent"}

ids, warnings = [], []
cells = {}
for d in root.iter("diagram"):
    print(f"diagram: id={d.get('id')!r} name={d.get('name')!r}")
    model = d.find("mxGraphModel")
    print(f"  page: {model.get('pageWidth')}x{model.get('pageHeight')}")
    for c in d.iter("mxCell"):
        cid = c.get("id")
        ids.append(cid)
        if cid in reserved:
            warnings.append(f"保留字 id: {cid}")
        cells[cid] = c

# 几何越界检查（vertex 且 parent 不是根）
def geom(c):
    g = c.find("mxGeometry")
    if g is None: return None
    return float(g.get("x", 0)), float(g.get("y", 0)), float(g.get("width", 0)), float(g.get("height", 0))

for cid, c in cells.items():
    if c.get("vertex") != "1": continue
    p = cells.get(c.get("parent"))
    if p is None or p.get("vertex") != "1": continue
    pg = geom(p); cg = geom(c)
    if not pg or not cg: continue
    pw, ph = pg[2], pg[3]
    if cg[0] + cg[2] > pw + 1 or cg[1] + cg[3] > ph + 1:
        warnings.append(f"越界: {cid} 在 {p.get('id')} 内 (子 {cg[0]+cg[2]:.0f}x{cg[1]+cg[3]:.0f} > 父 {pw:.0f}x{ph:.0f})")

edges = [cid for cid, c in cells.items() if c.get("edge") == "1"]
missing = [cid for cid, c in cells.items() if c.get("edge") == "1"
           and (c.get("source") not in cells or c.get("target") not in cells)]

print(f"\nvertex+edge 总数: {len(ids)} (edges: {len(edges)})")
print(f"edge 引用完整性: {'OK' if not missing else missing}")
print(f"保留字 id 检查: {'OK' if not any('保留字' in w for w in warnings) else warnings}")
print(f"边界检查: {'OK' if not any('越界' in w for w in warnings) else warnings}")
print("XML 解析: OK")
EOF
